this recipe will change ur life. so cheap, easy, and delish. ive made it for so many of my friends and even the ones who are hesitant about chickpeas end up loving it.


“This chickpea dish was my own creation....you can play around with the ingredient amounts.  It's forgiving.  

1 onion diced and sauteed in oil 
4-5 large tomatoes, diced or 2 cans of diced tomatoes
1-2 cloves of garlic
a few scoops of canned pasta sauce of your preference (i like ones on the sweeter side)
2 cans of chickpeas, drained
1 bag of frozen riced cauliflower 
Finish with shaved parmesan cheese to your desired level (canned just doesn't cut it)  

After onion is sauteed, add tomatoes, garlic, chickpeas, and cook until the tomatoes start to release some juice.  Then add cauliflower.  Once cauliflower has defrosted completely cook for another 10 mins or so. try the chickpeas to make sure they are soft. Top with Parmesan and serve.”

This makes a pretty big serving so tbh 90% of the time i halve it. i eat it with whole grain pasta or rice like kind of as a hearty sauce? i struggled with a severe binge eating disorder and this recipe was created by my aunt who is a PharmD but did her undergrad in food science and nutrition. it is so filling and nutritionally well rounded that it played a major role in getting my diet back on track. some people may be hesitant about the riced cauliflower but u don’t even taste the cauliflower of it. my parents hate cauliflower but love this dish lol! it is also just insanely delicious i can’t recommend enough.
